recipes.comment: task p29-w3-heat-smelter smoke row — hot water gives back its heat as HU and condenses to water (the upstream FM.Hot row Loader_Fuels.java:196/:198 verbatim: addRecipe0(T, -2, 1, FL.Hot_Water.make(1), FL.Water.make(1), ZL_IS)), eut -2 / duration 1 — the negative eut is the fuel-map semantics, |eut x duration| = 2 power per fluid unit books into the exchanger buffer
